findings: Six spindle geometry views inspected before SVG export. Approximately 21.8 cm shaft and 2.6 cm brass whorl; shaft thickness slightly amplified for readability. Connected point, shaft, low whorl, centred cop and hooked top agree with inspected instructor reference.
Cotton sliver is a separate material in an isolated equipment illustration. No bowl, operator or in-use support pose is claimed. Geometry is illustrative, not engineering validation.

Curved cotton surfaces triangulated; first projected shading was patchy. Two-tone paint reduced fragmentation and source size. A projected outer contour resolved faint small-size edges on white without altering equipment geometry.

Five native cards, nine accepted/Noto reference cards and ten actual IconManager variants personally inspected. Final revised spindle card and all ten runtime variants rechecked; other four source hashes unchanged.
Other four are flat symbolic diagrams without non-trivial spatial assembly. Solar panel and sound waves are conceptual notation, not an unverified circuit or particular workshop object.
